verdict.rationale: The only evidence of user-controlled scheduling is a marketing line saying Fieldwork's AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence "on your schedule." That suggests recurring evidence-collection workflows, but nothing documents how schedules are configured. Oneleet also runs code scans automatically once a day, but that is a fixed platform cadence rather than a user-defined recurring job. missing for 10: documented scheduler or cron-style configuration, user-defined recurring workflows beyond evidence collection, scheduling via API/MCP for AI-native use, independent or hands-on corroboration.
